title: Final Pressure Relation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and state the relationship p = u/3.

title: Adiabatic Process Relation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and state the relation pV^(4/3) = constant.

title: Value of Gamma
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine and state the value of gamma as 4/3.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show correct integration steps leading to the pressure and volume relations.

title: Energy Density Definition
description: Important Criteria: The student must define energy density and relate it to the total energy U.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student checks that units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the pressure and energy density relations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure all factors in the momentum and energy equations are included.
